profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
SW developer for automotive applications, CAN Protocol, automotive entertainment systems. Interested in migration projects and new technology like mobile applications and web services for automotive industry.

Work based in objectives, SW Quality Controls and, CMMI and Agyle methodologies for SW development.

company.name: Universidad Politecnica de Santa Rosa Jauregui

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
Professor: 
 Electric, 
 Electronic, 
 Digital Systems,
 Sensors and Actuators, 
 Operative Systems, 
 WEB Programming, 
 Languages and Automata.
 Advanced programming,
 Graphics and multimedia
 Electricity and magnetism.
 Distributed DataBase.
 SW Quality 
 Static.
 Linear algebra (bilingual program)
 Mobile applications
 Artificial intelligence

Projects developed:

1) AC and Air Washed module controlled with a microchip microcontroller and a PC program connected via zig bee technology for Educational purposes.

2) SAAD system, attendance and personnel control (web app based)

3) InterUPOLS is an Android Application for tablet and mobile use (this application connects to internet to download data from a server in order to display last result of polytechnic sport event in real time) available in google play store.

4) Smart house control is currently being developed ( the purpose of the project is to control a process through internet and a mobile app, the UPSRJ is collaborating in software section)

projects.title: Sistema Académico y Administrativo  at Universidad Politécnica de Santa Rosa Jauregui   (SAAD Web based Application)
projects.description:
This system was started as part of the initiative of the current administration through  the Research Department from Universidad Politecnica de Santa Rosa Jauregui.

This system borns as a necessity of manage the Human Resources assistance and after this project was extended to academic area.
